caption: The drawing features a single candlestick holder designed in the shape of a stylized fish or dolphin, with detailed scales and a curled tail forming the lower part of the object. The upper part is a hexagonal candle holder with a central hole for placing a candle. The fish's body curves upward, supporting the candle holder on its head, with one fin prominently shown extending outward. The object is rendered in varying shades of purple, providing depth and highlights that accentuate its three-dimensional form. The candlestick rests on a hexagonal base. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with a faint rectangular border surrounding the illustrated object. There are small brown stains on the background, especially near the top left corner. The artist's name, John Tarantino, is written in small capital letters in the lower right corner.
title: Dolphin Candlestick
